en.headline: Police receive 43 reports after two luxury consignment shops close
en.dek: Officers are investigating alleged unpaid consignment proceeds involving about HK$16.6 million after shops in Causeway Bay and Admiralty ceased operations.
body: Police said they had received 43 reports by mid-afternoon on Tuesday in connection with two second-hand luxury consignment shops that had stopped operating.

Thirty-seven reports concerned a shop on Russell Street in Causeway Bay, with alleged losses of about HK$14 million. Six reports related to a shop on Harcourt Road in Admiralty, with alleged losses of about HK$2.6 million. Customs said it had not yet received complaints but would examine whether any Trade Descriptions Ordinance issues arose.

The shops, known as Vootic and Obsessplanet (樂星), had previously accepted designer handbags and jewellery on consignment. Several customers told media that recent payments had bounced and that contact with the operators had been lost; one remaining branch was still open. No arrests had been announced.

zh.headline: 兩間二手名牌寄賣店結業 警方接獲43人報案
zh.dek: 涉及銅鑼灣及金鐘店舖，懷疑拖欠寄賣款項約1660萬元，重案組跟進。
body: 警方表示，截至周二下午3時已接獲43人報案，指兩間二手名牌寄賣店懷疑拖欠寄賣款項後失聯。
其中37人涉及銅鑼灣羅素街一店舖，涉款約1400萬元；另外6人涉及中區夏懣道一店舖，涉款約260萬元。海關暫未接獲舉報，會了解是否涉及《商品說明條例》。
涉事店舖為Vootic及樂星（Obsessplanet）。多名苦主稱近期支票彈票及無法聯絡負責人；樂星另有一間門市仍有營業。暫未有拘捕消息。
